QuestInfo.name: [Charity: Water] Water Wash
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9010010##k started a charity event to send clean water to the people of Rwanda. He needs your help.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9010010##k said you could hold on to a #b#t3994621##k for 30 minutes while you are logged in to transform it into a #b#t3994622##k.
QuestInfo.2: This #b#t3994622##k will be a great help for the people of Rwanda.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Clean Water Give Buff\n(HP, DEF/M. DEF increasing buff that's based on level)\n

0.0: I'm glad you're here, #b#h0##k. I've teamed up with an awesome group called Charity: Water to help the people of Rwanda with their water crisis.
0.1: We're trying to get them some clean water, but it's been really hard to stop all these crazies and monsters from contaminating the jugs. Do you think you'd have time to help?

yes.0: You're a life saver! Just hold on to one of these #b#t3994621#s#k and #rstay logged in for 30 minutes#k. That should be enough time for the purifying tablets I put in to do their magic.
yes.1: Just use the Event Notifier on the left side of the screen to tell me when it's all clean, okay?

no.0: Aww, seriously? But there's so much helping to be done!

item.0: I don't think the water inside the container is clean yet.
